a3.arrive.text: It's just dust, Bhai. And boxes. And... a lot of boxes.
Leave the heavy stuff to me! I lift weights. Well, I lifted one, once.

a3.cobwebs.text: Look who's brave now that the webs are gone.

a3.storage_floor.text: A dry floor keeps the rice dry. Simple science, nani.

a3.rack.text: A place for everything, and everything in its place.
You sound just like me fifty years ago!

a3.sacks.text: Sorry, Biralo. The rice is not a bed either.

a3.ladder.text: I can reach the top shelf! I can see the WHOLE room!
Hold on with both hands, Bhai!

a3.small_window.text: Fresh air! And a little bit of sky.

a3.curtain.text: I was saving this cloth for something special. This is special.

a3.fan.text: Whoa, whoa! Too fast! ...Okay, a little slower. Perfect.

a3.cabinet.text: Hajurama, there are recipes in this drawer! Sel roti, laddu, everything!
So that's where they went. Now you'll have to learn them, nani.

a3.bulb.text: Let there be light! And let it not flicker, please.

a3.crates.text: The ticking crate! It's... a clock?
Hajurba's clock. I thought it was lost.

a3.wall_clock.text: Tick, tock. Just like he's still here, keeping us on time.
He is, Hajurama. In every corner of this shop.

a3.outro.text: The whole ground floor is done. The counter, the front, the storage room.
And upstairs? Our kitchen still has the stove from my wedding.
That stove has made a thousand cups of tea. It deserves a rest!
Upstairs next! Can my room be blue?
One room at a time, Bhai. First, the kitchen!
